title: Distortion of the triangular ratio metric under Moebius transformations
summary: Let $\mathbb{U}$ be the unit disk in the complex plane. Denote by $s_\mathbb{U}(x,y)$ the triangular ratio metric in $\mathbb{U}$; the value of $s_\mathbb{U}(x,y)$ equals the ratio of the Euclidean distance $|x-y|$ to the value $\inf_{z\in \partial \mathbb{U}}(|x-z|+|z-y|)$.
